HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Ivory Variegation
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Cream and sage sectors concentrated on foliage; contrasting fruit and stems remain recognizable.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Crimson Blush
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Wine-red and dusky rose foliage blush, strongest on selected tips.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Moonfrost
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Cool sage-silver wax bloom with restrained pale margins.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Goldfreckled
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Ochre freckles and irregular gold mottling on foliage.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Aurora Veins
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Pale mint branching pigmentation over natural leaf tissue; no emitted light.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Velvetleaf
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Deep moss and forest-green foliage with softly shaded velvet-like tissue.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Lacquered
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Dark glossy-looking green foliage with intermittent pale reflections.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Dustbloom
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Soft chalk and warm sage powder concentrated in irregular leaf patches.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Silvered
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Silver-sage leaf tissue with directional pale highlights.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Halo-Edged
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Ivory inner leaf margins with a predominantly natural green interior.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Netveined
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Pale yellow-green reticulated markings within natural foliage.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Tigerstriped
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Broken ochre and muted brown bands interspersed with green tissue.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Marbled
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Organic sage and cream marbling, with original green visible between sectors.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Opaline
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Subtle rose, sage and pearl highlights; a static iridescence illusion.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Crystalline
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Angular pale mineral-like markings concentrated at foliage tips; no physical crystals.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Bioluminescent
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Sparse pale lime and mint flecks on green tissue; a pigment illusion, not emitted light.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Nebula Mottle
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Patchy wine-purple and olive mottling with pale speckles.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Coralbranch
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Muted salmon and copper branching markings on green tissue.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Prismatic
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Muted olive, copper and plum pigmentation in neighboring highlights.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Saltbloom
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Intermittent chalk-white deposits at foliage margins.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Ashen
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Soft gray-green dusty tissue with retained plant shading.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Boggloss
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Dark olive and jade wet-looking patches with subtle pale reflections.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Waxbound
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Warm jade and yellow-green waxy highlights.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Peatstained
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Earthy brown and olive pigment concentrated toward lower foliage.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Scorched Margins
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Copper-brown dry leaf rims and tips with retained green interior.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Honey Harvest
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Honey-gold pigmentation in contrasting fruit, seed or flower tissue; foliage remains green.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Ivory Harvest
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Cream-white reproductive tissue with retained natural shading.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Mulberry Harvest
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Deep mulberry and plum pigmentation in contrasting fruit or flower tissue.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Rose Harvest
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Soft rose-colored fruit and flower tissue, distinct from green foliage.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Bicolor Harvest
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Cream and red-blushed sectors in contrasting fruit or flower tissue.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Cream Margins
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Irregular cream leaf margins with a retained green center.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Lime Heart
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Yellow-green leaf centers and darker outer foliage.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Copper Tips
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Bronze and copper pigmentation concentrated in upper foliage.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Ivory Speckle
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Scattered ivory leaf spots with irregular natural spacing.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Burgundy Margins
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Wine-red leaf margins and dark green interior tissue.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Ruby Stalk
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Wine-red pigmentation concentrated in lower central green tissue; approximate stalk targeting.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Amber Stalk
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Golden ochre lower central tissue with naturally green outer leaves.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Striped Stalk
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Alternating wine and green markings on lower central tissue.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Blue Jade
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Muted blue-green foliage with jade highlights, retaining original fruit colors.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Two-Tone Canopy
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Deep green lower foliage with lighter lime-green upper growth.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Arching
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: A gently curved, asymmetric upright growth habit.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Fan-Crowned
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: A broad spreading upper canopy with a narrower base.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Rounded
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: A fuller middle canopy with compact rounded upper growth.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Weeping
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: A spreading canopy with drooping outer foliage.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Spired
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: A tapered, elongated upright canopy with narrow upper growth.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Plump Fruit
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Larger rounded fruit or flower structures, with the original foliage retained.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Long Fruit
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Elongated fruit or reproductive structures.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Broad Fruit
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Wider fruit or flower structures, leaving the canopy intact.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Clustered Fruit
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Closely overlapping reproductive lobes derived from the original art.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Thick Stalk
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Broadened automatically identified stem tissue; unchanged when anatomy is uncertain.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Bronze Flush
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Copper-bronze juvenile leaves that mature into deep green foliage.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Frostbud
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Cream-white juvenile tips and pale leaf margins which gradually green as the plant develops.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Autumn Crown
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Green juvenile foliage that develops golden and russet upper growth at maturity.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Ripening Blush
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Contrasting reproductive tissue ripens from pale honey to rose and mulberry tones.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Maturing Variegation
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Green young leaves gradually develop irregular cream and sage variegation.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Rigid Habit
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: A stiff, upright plant with very little wind movement.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Supple Habit
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: Flexible foliage that sways farther in the breeze.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Flutterleaf
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: A light, quick secondary flutter over ordinary swaying.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Nodding Habit
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: A gentle forward-and-back nod, with less sideways bending.

HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.label: Sweeping Habit
HorticultureNovelSeeds.VarietyTraitDef.description: A broad side-to-side sweep of the canopy.
